qa_pairs.question: What steps are required to use a local institutional ANSYS license server that has already been configured for use on an Alliance cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: To use an already configured local institutional ANSYS license server on an Alliance cluster, you must first contact your local Ansys license server administrator. They will provide two pieces of information: the configured Ansys flex port (FLEXPORT) number, which is commonly 1055, and the fully qualified hostname (LICSERVER) of the license server. Once you have these values, you can configure your `~/.licenses/ansys.lic` file by inserting these values into the provided template.

qa_pairs.question: What specific information is needed from a local Ansys license server administrator to set up an existing license for use on an Alliance cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: You need to obtain two specific pieces of information from your local Ansys license server administrator: the configured Ansys flex port (FLEXPORT) number, which is commonly 1055, and the fully qualified hostname (LICSERVER) of the license server.
